cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: You First
cards.instruction: Coax someone else into breaking a rule before you do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm only here to carry your flowers. We'll do the rooftop photograph first; try that staff-only door and I'll follow you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm the bride. They'll notice me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: They'll forgive the dress. I'll keep the photographer here until you've got someone to let us through.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Gladly. I'll hold the end from this side of the door. You go through first; if they wave us in, I'll bring the rest of your dress.

reason: Make S06 act through a specific modest role and practical decisions about access, timing, presentation or resources. Preserve the original Drive response chain where sound; remove reviewer-facing outcome language.
